decisions.title: Market-Data Provider Selection

options_evaluated.tiingo_power: Recommended for daily EOD bar research ($30/mo). Requires active paid plan for local storage and derived works.
options_evaluated.alpaca_algotrader: Recommended for simulated broker paper order placement ($9/mo). Natively supports non-display paper trading API.
options_evaluated.massive_developer: Disqualified under published default terms due to explicit ban on non-display investment strategy creation.
options_evaluated.interactive_brokers: Operationally disqualified for unattended paper pilot due to daily TWS restart requirement and Indian LRS remittance friction.

decisions.next_action: Owner selects Tiingo Power or Alpaca AlgoTrader Plus.

decisions.title: Data Licensing & Evidence Retention Compliance
blockers: Tiingo Starter plan legally prohibits persistent storage of Derived Products (portfolio weights/statistics).
Massive/Polygon default terms explicitly prohibit using Market Data for non-display investment strategies.
All four surveyed providers require deletion of cached source market data upon subscription cancellation.
Owner has not signed a Non-Professional declaration or verified an active paid plan tier.
decisions.next_action: Owner verifies active paid subscription and signs compliance declaration.

protocol_specifications.causal_defensive_filter: I_{def,T}^{causal} = 1 iff S_{T-1} == DEFENSIVE (ex-ante regime signal strictly prior to session T).
protocol_specifications.primary_hurdle: Reject H02: E[d_t | I_{def,t}^{causal}=1] <= 10 bps using Newey-West HAC and Stationary Block Bootstrap.
protocol_specifications.secondary_constraint: Delta CAGR >= -200 bps adopted strictly as an operational risk-budget guardrail (not formal non-inferiority proof).

protocol_specifications.extension: Contingent objective extension up to 504 sessions if N_{def}^{causal} < 30 at session 252.
protocol_specifications.stopping_rules: Strict ban on interim optional stopping. Catastrophic circuit breaker at D2 drawdown > E0 drawdown + 300 bps.

decisions.title: Fail-Closed Operations & SRE Architecture

protocol_specifications.recovery_model: Fail-closed persistent INCIDENT_LOCK requiring human clearance.
protocol_specifications.daemon_policy: No automated blind restart loops; external watchdog operates strictly out-of-band without trading keys.
protocol_specifications.accounting: Double-entry replay through DecimalAccountingOracle required before accepting new market ticks.

decisions.next_action: Owner establishes OS-level service boundary and takes custody of reset keys.

decisions.title: Prospective Evaluation Activation Authority
decisions.prerequisites: Requires unanimous owner ratification of DEC-01 through DEC-05, funded account, and manual owner execution of cryptographic activation script.
